Name: Pet Owls
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]By request, this mod adds 3 different owls you can have as pets! You can adopt barn, horned, or snowy owls. Credit for artwork goes to the lovely plurffle who always keeps their asset use perms open <3[/size]

[size=4]You can choose one of the owls right from the beginning, or you can adopt them later from Marnie's after getting your pet license. Price is 4000g by default but can be configured to whatever you like.[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
